shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at (−5, 2) in the left image with the circular marker at 4 beside the gray region in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The plotted branch includes (−5, 2) at its left endpoint. Right image: The highlighted intersection excludes 4, its right endpoint.
Rationales: The selected left cue includes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue excludes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
